title: Petrified Oak
body:
Description

The Petrified Oak is a tree type that is found on Finlay. It's located at the waterfall southwest of the Lighthouse.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Petrified Oak to complete schematics.

The Petrified Oak tree is a less common tree than the Birch trees but are easy to find. It's distinctive by the leaves and wood being darker than the Oak tree.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for $2 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $24.4 per stud. You can also use a Planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $30.5 per stud.

This tree type is ideal for building, due to its ability to obtain compared to its sell price.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Petrified Oak to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • The petrified oaks are the hardest trees to cut down on the Finlay island, taking less than a six full swings to cut down by the base via Tall Refined Axe.
